description: A research team is conducting the 'Youth Development Study'. Wave 1 has been completed. Your task is to set up the Wave 2 survey. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!). 1) Create a new survey titled 'Youth Development Study - Wave 2' by COPYING the existing 'Youth Development Study - Wave 1' survey. 2) In the new Wave 2 survey, DELETE the 'Baseline Demographics' question group (we do not need to ask this again). 3) KEEP the 'School Experience' and 'Family Context' groups exactly as they are. 4) ADD a new question group named 'Recent Changes'. 5) Inside 'Recent Changes', add a Yes/No question with the code 'moved' and question text 'Have you moved to a different home in the past 12 months?'. 6) Activate the new survey.
